description:
That boy could see sound.
Luca, a boy with branches sprouting from his head, serves as a bugler in a mercenary company that thrives on war. Though surrounded by conflict, he dreams of becoming a musician. One day, amid the chaos of battle, a mysterious power awakens within him. His journey soon brings him into contact with the Pontiff, who stands at the pinnacle of the nation; Zoe, a fellow Branch-Born; and many others whose lives are intertwined with his own. Through these encounters, Luca`s destiny begins to change in ways he could never have
imagined.
Arboral Year 1294—a battle that will determine the future is about to begin.
Source: Official Website

titles.title: The Bugle Call: Song of War
